module_metadata.title: Dynamic Webs
module_metadata.description: Dynamic Webs procedurally generates deterministic, level- and Region-aware spider webs with immutable spatial queries for Foundry Virtual Tabletop Scenes.

recommends.reason: Optional integration for Foundry v13 worlds. Dynamic Webs can use theripper93's Levels when available; Foundry v14 uses native Scene levels.

reachability.note: Unreachable means not reached from module.json static imports. It may still be used by macros, globalThis APIs, dynamic paths, or Foundry runtime behaviour.

classes.name: TokenSpanWebInteractionController
classes.comment: Initiating-client token movement handler for GM-authoritative whole-span destruction. preUpdateToken captures the true document origin and destination only on the client that initiated the movement. updateToken then follows that client's rendered Token placeable through the canvas ticker so every visible movement segment is tested. GM-originated movement is applied directly; player movement is submitted to the GM through the Dynamic Webs socket.

constants.name: WEB_CORNER_ASSET_DILATION_LEVELS
constants.comment: PIXI-version-tolerant thickness underlay for corner and span WebP assets. The former implementation used a custom fragment shader. Foundry defers custom shader compilation until the first filtered display is rendered, so an otherwise successful module load could still fail later with PixiJS' generic "Could not initialize shader" error. This implementation uses only PIXI's built-in BlurFilter. A crisp unfiltered sprite or mesh remains above the softened underlay, producing a controlled bloom-like widening without directional offset copies or module-authored GLSL.

constants.name: WEB_CARPET_PRIMARY_SORT_LAYER_OFFSET
constants.comment: Ambient Critters' ordinary under-token containers use sortLayer 650. Dynamic Webs resolves the same regular under-token lane, so carpets need a distinct sibling container just beneath it rather than relying on child zIndex. The one-unit offset keeps carpets above the preceding Foundry sort layer, while guaranteeing that under-token critter bodies sort after them. Firefly glows live in the Interface Canvas Group and therefore remain above both.

functions.name: createWallJunctionTopology
functions.comment: Build a deterministic, transient junction graph from independent Foundry wall segments. Existing endpoint nodes are seeded with the same quantised endpoint model historically used by WallCornerWebGenerator. A uniform-grid broad phase then discovers endpoint-on-segment contacts and interior wall crossings. Each accepted contact becomes a transient junction with one outward ray for every wall direction leaving that point. Collinear overlaps remain excluded. @param {object} [options={}] - Topology inputs. @param {ReadonlyArray<object>} [options.wallSegments=[]] - Plain walls. @param {number} [options.endpointTolerancePx=4] - Contact tolerance. @param {number} [options.gridSize=100] - Scene grid size in pixels. @param {number|null} [options.cellSizePx=null] - Optional broad-phase cell. @returns {Readonly<object>} Frozen junctions and diagnostics.

functions.name: buildWallJunctionTopology

functions.name: createWallJunctionSectors
functions.comment: Resolve the geometrically local angular sectors around one junction. A two-ray endpoint corner retains one historical smaller-angle sector. Junctions with three or more rays return every true adjacent sector around the point, including the wrap-around sector. Consumers may then apply their own angle, wall-role and length policies.

classes.name: WallSpanWebGenerator
classes.comment: Generate deterministic wall-to-wall webs across narrow passages. Detection samples structural walls, casts both local wall normals, and accepts the nearest broadly compatible opposing wall within the configured span. Wall pairs may be parallel, converging, diverging or moderately skewed; only near-perpendicular pairs are excluded. Repeated samples for the same wall pair are grouped before spacing and count limits are applied.
